answers.core: This concerns the behaviour of a built-in node.
answers.workaround:
It _can_ be worked around with scripting - by manually (re)implementing scrolling, or explicitly setting the embedded `ScrollBar`s' `focus_mode`; and it _may_ not be used often.

However, when it _is_ needed, it can be make-or-break for a UI's keyboard accessibility; and such functionality is easy to overlook for a developer who primarily uses a mouse or touch interface when testing their app.  So having this be out-of-the-box behaviour would be beneficial.

title: Allow keyboard scrolling of `ScrollContainer`s by default
